#### Resolve Git revision
_No operation description provided._
```bash
sha=$(git -C "{{ env.cwd }}" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
printf '{"git_short_sha": "%s"}' "$sha" > "$STATE_FILE"
```
